primitive: Precalculated exponential-bucket-bound mantissas (schemas 0-8) of Prometheus native histograms, required for bit-exact histogram_fraction/histogram_quantile/histogram_stddev/histogram_stdvar bucket bounds
module: github.com/prometheus/prometheus model/histogram/generic.go (table `exponentialBounds`), identical in the two pinned releases
approved_by: Main, 2026-11-04: numeric data only (511 float64 constants), no Prometheus code, evaluator or storage logic; needed because the entries are not derivable from a closed formula (tested: correct rounding, round-down, truncation to 15/16/17 digits, pow/exp/exp2, iterated sqrt of neighbours all differ from the table in 253-469 of 511 entries) and an empirical curve fit would extrapolate arbitrarily. Same approval class as the other generic vendored primitives; fully reversible by deleting this directory and the first-party fit it replaces.
source_container: conformance/query source lock: Prometheus 3.1.0 commit 7086161a93b262aa0949dbf2aba15a5a7b13e0a3 and 3.13.5 commit f497435984d1ca1d84cda5ed309387ac2eb1f8f6

files.table_digest_definition: SHA-256 of lines `schema:index:%016x\n` (IEEE-754 bits of each entry, schema-major then index), recomputed independently with go/parser over both pinned upstream sources and equal to this package's digest
adaptations: data-only extraction of the exponentialBounds literal; values re-emitted as Go float literals in shortest round-trip form
accessor Mantissa(schema, index) and documentation are first-party
excluded: getBound and getBoundExponential logic and every other upstream function
